summary: End-to-end testing of the Agency Multi-Tenant Platform (backend + frontend). Backend: 22/22 pytest tests passed against public URL (auth, apps CRUD, pages, activity, members, export .zip + mocked iOS build, AI editor Claude Sonnet 5, multi-tenant isolation, cross-tenant denial). Frontend: verified landing page, JWT login, auth guard, dashboard with 6 seeded apps and correct status counts (Tenants 6 / Active 4 / Maint 1 / Handover 1), search, new tenant creation, app detail with all 5 tabs, block builder (add hero), AI edit produced 'Try Free' in preview, page save, .zip download, iOS mock build reaching 100% with artifact toast, transfer toggle, member invite, activity feed.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking [data-testid="app-delete-btn"] with a native dialog auto-accept did not redirect to /dashboard in my run; backend DELETE /api/apps/:id works (verified in pytest). Likely uses a custom confirm modal rather than window.confirm — main agent should verify UI confirm and post-delete redirect wiring.

issues: AuthContext calls /api/auth/me on landing page for unauthenticated visitors, producing repeated 401 console errors. Cosmetic only — consider skipping the call when no auth cookies exist, or suppressing the console error.

action_items: OPTIONAL: The review request documented several data-testid values that don't match the actual implementation. Update code (or docs) to align. Current vs documented: login-email-input (docs: auth-email-input), login-password-input (docs: auth-password-input), status-{v}-btn (docs: status-chip-{v}-btn), new-app-industry-select (docs: new-app-industry-input), new-app-create-btn (docs: new-app-submit-btn), nav-logout dropdown item (docs: nav-logout-btn). Functionality is unaffected.
OPTIONAL: Verify UI delete flow triggers redirect to /dashboard after successful DELETE.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~900 lines with all routes, models, seed logic and export HTML template inline — consider splitting into routers/ (auth, apps, pages, members, export, ai) and services/ for maintainability.

get_current_user token-type heuristic in `Authorization: Bearer …` (checks that the token does NOT have two dots to route it as a session token) is fragile — prefer separate header prefixes or explicit endpoints.

AI editor blindly json.loads model output without a fenced-JSON safety net beyond stripping ``` — the current strip works for the common case but will fail on prose wrappers; consider extracting the first {...} block via regex as a fallback.
Frontend: AuthContext appears to call /api/auth/me on public routes producing 401s; gate the call on route or on presence of cookie.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 6 demo apps + activity logs on startup for admin user. Test suite also creates TEST_App_* apps and TEST_UI_App via the UI (deleted at end of pytest run; the UI test app may remain).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all critical endpoints incl. dual-auth, RBAC isolation, AI Claude Sonnet 5, zip export and mocked mobile build. Actual UI testids differ from those listed in the review request (see action_items). Use login-email-input / login-password-input / auth-jwt-submit-btn / new-app-{name-input, industry-select, desc-input, create-btn} / status-{active,maintenance,handover}-btn / tab-{overview,builder,handoff,activity,members}-btn / builder-add-{type}-block-btn / builder-ai-prompt-input / builder-ai-run-btn / builder-save-btn / export-source-zip-btn / export-ios-build-btn / client-transfer-toggle / member-invite-email-input / member-invite-submit-btn / app-delete-btn / app-card-<slug>.
